children: Currenc Group shares rose Thursday after the company agreed to support the cryptocurrency tokenization of a portion of Mint Incorporation's shares.

Currenc said that its subsidiary, Currenc Capital will support the issuer-sponsored tokenization of a portion of artificial intelligence and robotics company Mint's Nasdaq-listed Class A ordinary shares on the ethereum and solana blockchains.

The process of tokenization means taking traditional stock shares in the company and creating digital tokens that live on public blockchains, in this case on ethereum and solana blockchains. Currenc noted it was one of the first Nasdaq-listed companies to tokenize its ordinary shares in April.

"Tokenization allows a listed company to modernize how its shares are owned and accessed, without changing a single right of the underlying security," said Currenc Founder, Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Alex Kong.
The company said that it will provide end-to-end advisory and facilitation to support the rollout.
